background.name: Storm charcoal
background.job: Sky, storm clouds, the space around every diorama, and the neighbouring states on the map.

subject.name: Sandstone red
subject.job: The land: red rock, canyon walls, the terrain of the state. Its pale end, desert cream (#E6D6B8), is the same family: salt crust, pale sand, dry lakebeds.

accent.name: Turquoise water
accent.job: The one accent and the story's actor: rain runoff, rivers, rising lakes, flooded flats, runoff arrows.

highlight.name: Fresh green
highlight.job: Data and life: temporary greenery, new wetlands, and the Great Basin drainage on the divide map.

cream.name: Desert cream
cream.job: The light end of the sandstone ramp (salt flats, sand, limestone). Not a fifth paint colour.

storm.name: Storm daylight
storm.job: Key light for days 1-29: cool, overcast, about 6,500 K.

clearing.name: Clearing sun
clearing.job: The one lighting change: warm low sun when the clouds break on day 30 (about 4,500 K).

text.name: Off-white
text.job: Titles, captions, stat numbers, map labels.

secondary.name: Warm grey
secondary.job: Stat labels, asides, 'imagined scenario' tags, legend text.

panelFill.name: Charcoal panel
panelFill.job: Every caption, stats, legend, gauge and end-card panel (18 px background blur).

panelEdge.name: Warm grey edge
panelEdge.job: 1.5 px panel outline; the dark halo behind 3d map labels.
